about_the_game:
Roll the Nata de Coco to the goal in this charming puzzle game!

Because Nata de Coco has little bumps on its surface, you’ll need to roll it skillfully and control its orientation to reach the goal.

Various gimmicks and obstacles stand in your way.
Each one is simple on its own—but when they interact, they create surprising depth and complexity.

There are 50 stages in total.
Try to clear them all, or, if you’re a puzzle expert, challenge yourself to reach the goal in the fewest possible moves for an extra layer of fun!

Good luck!

◆ Story ◆

You are a piece of expired Nata de Coco that has lost its memory.

“I was supposed to be delicious… so why hasn’t anyone eaten me for so long…?”

Determined to find out why you were forgotten, you leap out of your can in search of answers.
Along the way, you’ll encounter many other soft, jiggly, and delicious treats.

What fate awaits Nata de Coco…?!
